_comment: Fixed-keyword-enum CSS properties, scoped ONLY to properties this codebase actually emits as a literal PHP-variable-interpolated value in render.php (grepped 2026-08-13 — see check-editor-render-parity.js CHECK B). Versioned JSON data file, not a hardcoded dict buried in script logic (R-31-1 precedent: attr-classification-overrides.json / css-property-classifications.json). property_suffixes (sgs-framework.db) was checked first and does NOT carry this concept — it maps ATTRIBUTE-NAME SUFFIXES to a css_property, not a css_property's VALID VALUE SET, so this is a genuinely new concept, not a duplicate. Deliberately NOT a universal CSS-property table — every entry here was found live in a render.php string-concatenation emission. Add a property here ONLY when a real emission site is found for it; do not pre-populate speculative properties. Values sourced from MDN (author's general CSS knowledge, cross-checked against the MDN property reference pages for each property at build time 2026-08-13) — properties with length/percentage/colour components mixed into their keyword set (e.g. object-position, background-position, flex-basis) are OUT OF SCOPE by design: this table only covers KEYWORD-ONLY value sets Check B can validate with simple set membership.
